scope.description: the scope of the vault report

domains_without_autofill_count.description: Count of credentials where autologin is disabled. Autologin is disabled for a credential when the user has unchecked the 'automatically log me in to this website' setting from the detailed view. This property has been deprecated because of a misleading naming. It has been replaced by password_with_autologin_disabled_count

passwords_with_autologin_disabled_count.description: Count of credentials where autologin is disabled. Autologin is disabled for a credential when the user has unchecked the 'automatically log me in to this website' setting from the detailed view. This property has been deprecated because of a misleading naming.

password_changer_compatible_credentials_.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. Count of credentials compatible with password changer

passwords_compromised_count.description: Count of passwords in the vault currently compromised by public breaches or dark web breaches

passwords_compromised_through_dark_web_c.description: Count of passwords in the vault currently compromised by dark web breaches

passwords_excluded_count.description: Count of passwords excluded from security score

passwords_safe_count.description: Count of safe passwords in the vault

passwords_total_count.description: Count of passwords in the vault

passwords_reused_count.description: Count of reused passwords in the vault

passwords_weak_count.description: Count of weak passwords in the vault

passwords_with_otp_count.description: Count of passwords with Dashlane OTP

passwords_protected_with_master_password.description: Count of passwords protected with master password (either at the individual level or global level)

passwords_compromised_compatible_with_pa.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. The count of compromised passwords supported by password changer in the user's vault

passwords_weak_compatible_with_password_.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. The count of weak passwords supported by password changer in the user's vault

passwords_reused_compatible_with_passwor.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. The count of reused passwords supported by password changer in the user's vault

security_alerts_count.description: Count of security alerts (public breach and dark web, active and inactive)

security_alerts_active_count.description: Count of currently active security alerts (public breach and dark web)

dark_web_alerts_count.description: Count of dark web alerts (active and inactive)

dark_web_alerts_active_count.description: Count of currently active dark web alerts

items_shared_count.description: Count of shared items in the vault

items_total_count.description: Count of items in the vault

collections_total_count.description: Count of distinct collections in the vault

items_per_collection_average_count.description: Average number of items per collection - only collections with items

collections_per_item_average_count.description: Average number of collections per item - only items with collections

collections_shared_count.description: Count of distinct shared collections in the vault

item_type_collections_count.description: Count of distinct collections, within item type(s)

item_type_collections_shared_count.description: Count of distinct shared collections, within item type(s)

item_type_multiple_collections_count.description: Count of items with multiple collections associated, within item type(s)

item_type_multiple_collections_shared_co.description: Count of shared items with multiple collections associated, within item type(s)

item_type_single_collection_count.description: Count of items with a single collection associated, within item type(s)

item_type_single_collection_shared_count.description: Count of shared items with a single collection associated, within item type(s)

item_type_shared_count.description: Count of shared items, within item type(s)

item_type_total_count.description: Count of items, within item type(s)

item_type_counts.description: Object with counts by item type grouping
